headline: Khandwala Securities reports financial results for the quarter ended September 2026
hook: September quarter numbers are now out
summary: Khandwala Securities Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges following a board meeting. These filings provide registered shareholders and market participants with updated performance metrics for the company during the second quarter of the financial year. Routine quarterly disclosures allow retail investors to track the fundamental health and revenue trajectory of listed financial services firms.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data updates your valuation view on the stock
